items.label: S. 4668
items.summary: The Protect College Sports Act of 2026 establishes federal rules governing name, image, and likeness (NIL) agreements for college student athletes, creates limited antitrust exemptions for sports broadcasting rights, and sets standards for student health, safety, transfers, and scholarship protections. It also establishes a competitive grant program to improve broadband, technology, and sports media infrastructure at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).
items.title: Protect College Sports Act of 2026

items.label: S. 528
items.summary: The GLRI Act of 2026 extends the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative through fiscal year 2030 and authorizes an appropriation of $475,000,000 for each fiscal year from 2027 through 2030 to carry out programs and projects that protect and restore the Great Lakes.
items.title: GLRI Act of 2026

items.label: S. 3315
items.summary: The Health Care Cybersecurity and Resiliency Act of 2026 aims to strengthen cybersecurity measures and resources across the health care and public health sectors. It directs federal agencies to collaborate on threat information sharing and incident responses, requires non-governmental health entities and covered entities to implement minimum risk-based cybersecurity practices within 36 months, establishes grants and guidance specifically for rural and safety-net health facilities, and sets up working groups and strategic plans to expand the specialized workforce and reduce duplicative reporting burdens.
items.title: Health Care Cybersecurity and Resiliency Act of 2026

items.label: H.R. 7730

latest_action.text: Message on Senate action sent to the House.

items.summary: The Bankruptcy Threshold Adjustment Act of 2026 restores debt limit changes that expired in 2024 for small business reorganizations (Subchapter V) and wage earner bankruptcy plans (Chapter 13). It raises the debt limit for small business bankruptcies to $7.5 million and for Chapter 13 bankruptcies to $2.75 million, while combining secured and unsecured debt limits for Chapter 13.
items.title: Bankruptcy Threshold Adjustment Act

items.label: S. 3383
items.summary: The Unlocking Native Lands and Opportunities for Commerce and Key Economic Developments Act of 2025 amends federal laws related to Indian land leasing and rights-of-way. Specifically, it expands leasing provisions for federally recognized tribes and permits Indian tribes to grant rights-of-way across their tribal land for any purpose without the direct approval of the Secretary of the Interior, provided they have an approved tribal regulation containing an environmental review process.
items.title: Unlocking Native Lands and Opportunities for Commerce and Key Economic Developments Act of 2025
